(2) `review.upsert_item`: same-plan entries replace IN PLACE (position kept), new plans appended, resolved write-once, lead follows candidates[0].plan - so in a run that only appends/replaces, the lead (and the item file name) can never move: the tests may assert exactly one item file per site.
